_comment: [armor-template-generator] Human-maintained definition of the AI armour compositions.
Read by tools/gen/gen_ai_armor_templates.py. No country tag is ever a GATING term here:
classification stays in WA_AI_CONFIG and eligibility in the WA_AI_TEMPLATES_* scripted
triggers named by reference. Tags appear only inside the six COUNTRY_SOV_* target IDS of the
light_support family - the historical tank park, admitted by
WA_AI_CONFIG_pursues_historical_tank_park, which is the Country-layer exception of
principle 2. No technology list is copied either.

waves._comment: A9: +0.5 is a FLAT per-battalion addition; 12 x 2.5 = 30 = 15 x 2.
waves._motorized_comment: A14 (OPEN): the screenshot's -2 names mechanized battalions. With the flat +0.5 every battalion is 2.5 wide, so a motorized division that holds the doctrine and has no wave twin is 15 x 2.5 = 37.5 wide. true emits motorized wave twins with the same -1/-2 and lands them on 30; false keeps the literal screenshot rule and leaves the motorized case oversized.

composition._variant_block_comment: A13 RESOLVED (owner, 2026-09-19): the block keeps the screenshot's 3 battalions. SPG line battalions are width 3 at base, but pre_assault_bombardment (width_assumptions) takes them to 2, so the block is 6 wide in every case. mode 'width' remains available if that assumption is ever dropped.

width_assumptions._comment: Width is computed with these sub-doctrines held. pre_assault_bombardment is tier 0 artillery, available = always yes, ai_will_do base = 1, and it takes combat_width -1 off every SPG line battalion: that is what makes the 3-battalion SPG block 6 wide like an assault or infantry-support block, and it is why A13 keeps the screenshot's 3 battalions. Drop a name from this list and the widths it pays for stop being true.

motorized_plane._comment: A country without mechanized infantry is a country one generation behind: the old ladder gave it 6 of its 124 medium targets. The motorized plane therefore carries the base composition and the regimental axes only - dropping the line variant and the SPAA company there removes a third of the whole product for a state every country leaves within a couple of years.

regimental_artillery._comment: A8: heavy SPG in a heavy division takes all 5 and outranks the rocket mix. No heavy regimental SPG unit exists today; validate.py reports the gap instead of inventing one. NOT IMPLEMENTED: the screenshot's Mech SPG rung (between Mot Pack Artillery and Mech Rocket) would need a third artillery state, which multiplies every medium and modern target by 1.5. Recorded as a deviation rather than shipped silently.

support_spine._comment: Ordered divisional fill, capped at composition.divisional_slots. 'chassis_map' picks the unit from the family's main chassis; 'fallback' is the explicit A4 non-heavy fallback.

light._comment: mode=declared: the light family is a CONVERSION machine as much as a composition. Its composition targets are resolved from `facts`, so the 10-line / 5-mobile / 30-width rules own them, but they keep the codes the hand-written ladder writes (WA_AI_TEMPLATES_calculate_light_armor_template). Its transition rungs and FINALs are verbatim: they are deliberate medium/light blends that walk a fielded division into the medium role, and resolving them would rewrite the state machine.

profiles._comment: [armor-template-generator] A3 removed the 20-width terrain exception: the marsh/mountain branch that wrote 5000 is deleted from WA_AI_TEMPLATES_calculate_light_armor_template in the same change, so such a country falls through to this 30-width target.

[armor-template-generator] A3 removed the 20-width terrain exception: the marsh/mountain branch that wrote 5001 is deleted from WA_AI_TEMPLATES_calculate_light_armor_template in the same change, so such a country falls through to this 30-width target.

The SPAA-less twin of 5107, the shape the medium ladder already uses (6105 bare, 6106 +light
SPAA, 6107 +medium SPAA). Without it a light-only country holding TDs and infantry-support
tanks but no SPAA falls all the way to 5103 and fields neither its TD battalion nor its TD
company. Keep the regimental pair at one artillery-type + one anti-tank-type company: that
shape holds across all 74 armour templates, and this block was the only one that broke it.

[light-td-coverage] The four cells where a country holding light tank destroyers fielded
none: the TD-bearing variants above all require light SPAA, so without these a TD country
with no SPAA fell to 5101/5102 and lost both its TD battalion and its TD company. Strictly
additive - each sits BELOW the variant it is the reduced form of, so no existing cell moves.
Shape rules they follow, invariant across the armour templates: one artillery-type plus one
anti-tank-type regimental company, and exactly one AA company (heavy_anti_air_mot without
light SPAA, light_self_propelled_anti_air with it).

[light-spaa-coverage] the SPAA forms that carry NO tank destroyer. Every other light rung
holding light SPAA also demands a TD (5104, 5107, 5108, 5118) or an SPG (5106), so a country
whose SPAA chassis unlocks before its TD one fielded no SPAA at all. Assumes the component
gate behaves like its siblings 5102 / 5103 / 5117: reversible until the stock term latches it.
One AA company only - light_self_propelled_anti_air REPLACES heavy_anti_air_mot, never adds.
First Transition to Medium

[armor-class-handoff] TD-less transition rungs, the post-boundary conversion path for a
country holding no light tank destroyer. Shape rules kept: one artillery-type plus one
anti-tank-type regimental company, exactly one AA company, medium share 4 of 10 line tank
battalions, replace_with onto the same-role FINAL step like every transition rung.

[armor-class-handoff] MIS twins of the five MEC rungs (52xx = 51xx + 100): identical
compositions, replace_with aimed at the inf-support FINAL instead of the pure one. The
light calculator picks a twin when WA_MEDIUM_ARMOR_TEMPLATE sits in the 6105-6110 family,
so the conversion ends on the composition the medium role targets — a pure 9+6 FINAL is
never captured by a role targeting 6/3/6 and the country keeps two competing templates.

[armor-class-handoff] The FINAL step of the conversion chain: the pure-medium composition
declared IN the light role, because a replace_with must resolve inside its own role group
(vanilla chains its eras inside ONE role). Enabled by trigger, not flag - no calculator
writes these. Exit = engine best-match capture by the medium role at full composition.
Keep LAST in the group so the flag-selected transition stays targeted first.

[armor-class-handoff] The inf-support FINAL: the line shape the GENERATED medium role
targets when the infantry-support variant wins its chain and the industrial cut leaves no
support battalion (7 armour + 3 infantry-support + 5 mechanized), so the medium role's
best-match capture sees its own target instead of a shape it never claims. Reached from
the MIS rungs directly, or from the pure MEC FINAL's era-chain hop.

modern._comment: [modern-chassis-tier] Only the hull steps up; every other component keeps the tier the country researches and stocks. Owner ruling 2026-09-19: NO light chassis in a modern or a heavy division, whatever the chain says - the only exception is the reconnaissance company, which is light in every family. So the modern family enumerates the medium tier only; the medium family keeps its light fallbacks (A15). Own code range replaces the old +500 offset.

heavy._comment: A11: a heavy line carries no medium-support quota. A4: heavy candidates only here; A6 company forbidden here.

light_support._comment: mode=declared, every target verbatim. This family is a STATE MACHINE, not a composition set: a 1936 starting park replaced at match 0.9, the Soviet 44-battalion mechanised corps and its convert twin, the transition rungs and the FINALs they hand a division to. The COUNTRY_SOV_* profiles are the historical tank park (WA_AI_CONFIG_pursues_historical_tank_park) and are deliberately country-specific: they reproduce a real 1941 corps, not an archetype. Phase codes 15000-15016 are written by the hand-written WA_AI_TEMPLATES_calculate_light_support_armor_template, which owns the phase logic; this registry owns only what each phase FIELDS.

profiles.width_exception: 18: the 1936 starting park, replaced at match 0.9 by the 30-width target
profiles._comment:
[light-support-field-upgrade] Bridge: engine field-upgrade only moves a deployed division to a
target's `replace_with`, so without this step the 1936 8-battalion "Tankovaya brigada" never
reaches the 30_MOT below (vanilla ENG starter pattern). `has_template` retires it — the gate
and the 1.0 best-match are the same template object, so while it exists the role target flips
straight to 30_MOT. The second `value = 15000` read is deliberate: one flag, two targets.

profiles.width_exception: 18: the 1936 starting park, replaced at match 0.9 by the 30-width mix target
profiles._comment:
[historical-tank-park] Same bridge as the STARTER above, for the MIXED path — `replace_with`
is a static token, so each destination needs its own starter. The flag VALUE (15000 pure /
15001 mixed, latched once in the type-14 calculator) keeps exactly one pair alive; enables
never read the live mixed trigger. Composition and prio are deliberately identical.

profiles.width_exception: 44: the Soviet mechanised corps of 1941, deliberately oversized
profiles._comment:
[historical-tank-park] Exact AI-only 1936 Soviet OOB bridge. It lives in this role group,
rather than the country file, because replace_with cannot resolve across role groups.
[light-support-conversion] The VALUE alone keys this target, never the mission: the calculator
moves the park to 15009 only at the pulse after the mission ends, so a mission term here leaves
the role with no enabled target until then. Assumes 15006 is written only while the mission
counts the park; a 15006 read with no mission and no 15009 pulse pending means that changed.

profiles.width_exception: 44: the same corps once the conversion window opens
profiles._comment:
[historical-tank-park] The active-mission target intentionally has no replacement chain. This
post-mission copy alone owns the conversion pointer, so the Soviet starting corps cannot advance
before the mission closes.
[light-support-conversion] PONT phase only (15009, K pulses after the mission): an armed
bridge re-selects itself by priority (15 over the MIX's 10) once the divisions it moved no
longer match it at 0.9, and walks them back toward 12/6/4 - so the calculator drops this
value after K pulses and the MIX alone holds the role (15010). While the 1936 brigades
exist, STARTER_MIX (same base 15, declared first) is the selected target and it is ITS
chain that puts the arrow on the MIX; this one is selected once the brigade is gone. Either
way the arrow lands on the MIX, and STABLE keeps it there for whatever has not moved yet.

[historical-tank-park] The MIXED composition: one target consuming BOTH chassis (one target
per role is an engine constraint), so the historical park fields its plain lights inside the
same divisions — 90 lights + 175 supports each. 7 support / 5 mot, not 6/6: at 150 supports
per division the 10k fielded bar needs ~68 divisions, past what the run window can train;
175 crosses at ~59. Enable = the latched 15001, exclusive with pure 30_MOT by flag value.
4+4 regimental supports, not 5+5: three battalion types shrink the reachable grid and 10 RS
on 15 battalions has zero slack (designer-deadlock rule).
[light-support-conversion] For the temporary corps: destination of the PONT bridge (15009),
then the SOLE target of the STABLE phase (15010) until the T-34 / KV-1 opens the window.

[historical-tank-park] Conversion rungs (values 15002-15005, emitted by the calculator when
the run is over and the park still fielded): each targets the park's own shape so fielded
divisions match at ~1.0, and its replace_with is the same-group FINAL below (a cross-group
pointer at the medium templates stalls the switch - the [armor-class-handoff] stall). This
is the light-support twin of that conversion window; without it the park decommissions in 1942.

[light-support-conversion] Conversion rungs of the temporary corps: 15007 MOT / 15008 MEC into
the medium FINALs, 15013 MOT / 15014 MEC into the heavy FINALs (destination class latched by
the calculator at window entry: medium on the T-34, heavy only while medium is still shut).
Target = the 30w MIX shape the STABLE phase fields, so the park matches at ~1.0 and the
designer has nothing to drift toward while the switch waits; a residual 44w division rides
the same switch (the 0.8 bar is a template-level score, not a per-division one). Armed while
any template still contains a support battalion - the chain re-fires every pass against that
template - then the calculator moves to the FINAL-only value and this rung goes dark.

[historical-tank-park] The FINAL step, same shape as the [armor-class-handoff] pair in
WA_light_armor_role: a replace_with must resolve inside its own role group (the cross-group
pointer at the medium templates is the stall the owner measured live at match 0.8125).
Exit = engine best-match capture by the destination role at full composition. Keep the
FINALs LAST in group: a rung and its FINAL tie at base 10, and the first declared wins.
[light-support-conversion] Enabled under the rung values (CONVERT-1) AND under the
FINAL-only values 15011 / 15012 / 15015 / 15016 (CONVERT-2): once the rung goes dark the
FINAL is the role's only target, so nothing can walk the moved divisions back.
[armor-class-handoff] The destination is the medium role's CURRENT target, 10 + 5. A FINAL that mirrors an older shape makes the converting division land on a class nobody chose.
[armor-class-handoff] The destination is the medium role's CURRENT target, 10 + 5. A FINAL that mirrors an older shape makes the converting division land on a class nobody chose.

[light-support-conversion] Heavy FINALs, mirrors of the heavy role's 30_MOT (7100) and
30_MEC_MECHANIZED_SPAA (7105) targets so the heavy role captures them at full composition.
Reached only when the park converts while the medium class is still shut (KV-1 before T-34).

light_to_medium._comment: A5: direct role transfer, medium first, heavy only when no medium destination is eligible. No CONVERT template graph.
